integrity: The expected Fisher information is derived from the exact Shanker likelihood, transferred unchanged through the parameter-independent unit transformation, and independently checked by numerical integration. Posterior propriety under the source's log-uniform kernel is proved by endpoint bounds.
scientific_limitations: The finding does not recompute the source's simulation tables or posterior summaries under the actual Jeffreys-rule prior.
The source's \(1/\alpha\) prior gives a proper posterior for every nonempty sample in the open unit interval, so the existing Bayesian calculations remain interpretable under a log-uniform prior.
No claim is made that the Jeffreys-rule prior is preferable to all proper weakly informative priors in applications.
title: Exact Jeffreys prior for the unit Shanker model
